title: ATLAS: Scaffold-Free Algorithm Synthesis by LLMs via Embedding-Guided Quality-Diversity Search
abstract: arXiv:2608.15546v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most LLM-based automated algorithm design methods optimize a designated component within a human-specified scaffold, fixing overall organization and component interactions. We present ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework for scaffold-free full-algorithm synthesis in combinatorial optimization. The problem specification supplies objectives and constraints; a minimal I/O interface fixes only instance and solution formats; the LLM chooses and restructures components, interactions, and control flow. This freedom enlarges the search space, risking invalid candidates and premature convergence to one design region. ATLAS independently detects execution, interface, and feasibility failures, recomputes objectives, and applies error-conditioned repair; similarity-based archive management preserves algorithms across embedding-space regions to counter premature convergence. translated_title: ATLAS：通过嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索实现基于LLM的无脚手架算法综合
translated_abstract: 大多数基于大语言模型（LLM）的自动算法设计方法是在人工指定的脚手架内优化某个指定组件，固定了整体组织和组件间的交互。我们提出了ATLAS，一个用于组合优化中无脚手架全算法综合的嵌入引导的质量多样性框架。问题规范提供了目标和约束；一个最小的输入/输出接口仅固定实例和解决方案的格式；LLM负责选择和重组组件、交互以及控制流。这种自由度扩大了搜索空间，但可能导致无效候选和过早收敛到单一设计区域的风险。ATLAS独立检测执行、接口和可行性失败，重新计算目标，并应用基于错误的修复；基于相似性的档案管理保留嵌入空间区域中的算法，以对抗过早收敛。其三层搜索优化最佳设计，并给其他设计提供多样性。
tldr: 本文提出ATLAS框架，利用嵌入引导的质量多样性搜索，在无预定义脚手架的情况下，由LLM自动合成组合优化问题的完整算法，并通过错误修复和多样性管理应对搜索空间扩大带来的挑战。
en_tdlr: This paper presents ATLAS, an embedding-guided quality-diversity framework that enables LLMs to synthesize complete combinatorial optimization algorithms without predefined scaffolds, addressing invalid candidates and premature convergence through error-conditioned repair and similarity-based archive management.
